svg.font-family: Noto Sans SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Source Han Sans SC, sans-serif

g.text: adc_ref_servo | Differential input, current mirror and compensated gain stage
INP rises -> NB falls -> OUT rises. Implicit bodies: NMOS -> VSS; all PMOS, including MZERO -> AVDD18.
All MOS: W/L = 8u/1u, nf4. Mirror x4; output PMOS x16; damping PMOS x8; other MOS x1.
MOM: 80 fingers, 40u length, 50n width/space, layers 1..5. CC0 x4; CC1 and CC2 x1.
